description: Shared Renovate preset of GravionLabs (extends: github>GravionLabs/ci).
No pull request for a release younger than 7 days: a compromised release of a package, crate or action is usually withdrawn within days.
Actions are pinned to a commit SHA with the version as a comment.
At most two open pull requests at a time, against the default branch.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A fix for a known vulnerability is not held back.

packageRules.description: Own code: a repository that pins the shared workflows by commit SHA gets a new release of GravionLabs/ci at once.
